LOOK: Department of National Defense - Philippines Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. and Japanese Defense Minister Shinjirō Koizumi witness the live-fire exercise of Japan's Type 88 surface-to-ship missile system at the Paoay Sand Dunes in Ilocos Norte on Wednesday (May 6, 2026), highlighting the interoperability among the Armed Forces of the Philippines and partner forces. 

Conducted as part of "Balikatan" Exercise 2026, the activity showcased the precision strike capabilities of Japan’s Type 88 missile system designed to defend coastal areas and deter maritime threats. | @PriamN (Photos courtesy of the @dndphl Facebook Page)

#Balikatan2026
